name: my-reverse-proxy
description: The project contains settings and configurations required for running a reverse proxy on the local server.

scripts.traefik:start: npm run traefik:setup && docker compose up traefik -d
scripts.traefik:restart: npm run traefik:setup && docker compose up traefik -d --force-recreate
scripts.pihole:start: npm run pihole:setup && docker compose up pihole -d
scripts.pihole:restart: npm run pihole:setup && docker compose up pihole -d --force-recreate
